name: Adobe
description: Adobe is a software company whose Developer Console issues credentials for Adobe APIs and services.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Candidate credential families enumerated from nine pages of the Adobe Developer Console authentication documentation on developer.adobe.com, read on 2026-10-04 (cited per claim in the family contracts); the list is what those pages name, not a complete inventory. API key credentials and client IDs are public identifiers, not families: the API key credential contains only an API key and no secrets.
